picks.title: NVIDIA's Lyra 2.0 Turns a Single Image Into an Explorable 3D World, With Persistent Environments and Real-Time Rendering
picks.excerpt: NVIDIA's Lyra 2.0 generates an explorable, persistent 3D world from a single image by combining AI video generation, spatial memory and 3D reconstruction, rendered in real time - a new world-model version aimed at environment creation.
picks.rationale: New world-model release (v2.0) that turns one concept image into a persistent explorable 3D environment - directly relevant to environment artists and level blockout.

picks.title: Artists at the center: How InnoGames integrated gen AI into its art pipeline
picks.excerpt: In a guest article, InnoGames head of art Dario Berruti explains how the studio integrated generative AI into its game-art production workflows while keeping artists at the center.
picks.rationale: First-hand art-pipeline playbook from a studio head of art - the most directly actionable item for game artists in the pool.

picks.title: Google AI developer's unauthorized iPhone Duo port of the Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake, made with Gemini 4, draws backlash and is deleted
picks.excerpt: Google employee Ammaar Reshi posted on 11-07 that he had used Gemini 4 to get Nintendo's full Ocarina of Time remake running on iPhone Duo; the post drew criticism over engineering ethics and IP and has since been deleted.
picks.rationale: New incident in the AI-port/IP debate, notable because a Google AI developer did it with Gemini 4 and then pulled it under backlash.

picks.title: 完全オフライン、無制限、53言語対応。「日本発の翻訳AI」無償公開から数日、ゲーマー向けツールも続々登場
picks.excerpt: Days after Preferred Networks released its free, fully offline translation model PLaMo 3 Translate (53 languages, no usage limits), developers are releasing gamer-facing translation tools built on it.
picks.rationale: Free offline 53-language translation model already spawning gamer/localisation tools - practical for indie localisation and a fresh release.

picks.title: Jackbox Games isn't interested in AI development: 'All that is done by people, and we have no intention of changing that'
picks.excerpt: Jackbox CEO Mike Bilder says the studio's comedy, writing and art will stay human-made and it has no intention of replacing people or people-made editorial and art with generative assets, while allowing AI's use for tooling and research.
picks.rationale: A named studio's explicit policy line (human-made writing/art, AI only for tooling/research) - a concrete stance studios can benchmark against.
